svg.title: Three definitions of a cooperative group
svg.desc: Each panel shows two CUDA thread blocks with 64 threads each. Green dots indicate group members. A generic group selects arbitrary threads across both blocks. A CTK group selects threads within one block boundary. A CCCL group selects a complete 32-thread warp as its unit within one block boundary.
svg.text: Hierarchy units within an upper boundary
Each block shows 64 threads; layout is schematic.
